version: V3.4.2 D772 Section 2 Lesson 2 Graphical Displays
status_basis: Engineering estimate against the current Majick Studies roadmap, not a test score.
stable_base: V3.3.12 Faster Evolutions with V3.3.10 protected Phaser motion foundation
what_changed: Main app shell now reports V3.3.17 consistently after every render.
Service worker registration is disabled during active development so stale shells cannot take over newer releases.
Previously installed Majick service workers are retired and old Majick caches are cleared.
The legacy snag modal is replaced by a V3.3.17 runtime handler that ignores resource-only failures.
Corrected 60 individual Guardian evolution action assets are deployed.
Phase 4 movement logic remains the protected movement controller.
Each course now keeps its own academic record: notes, generated questions, answers, mistakes, mastery, readiness, repair queue, and study streak.
Majick account XP and Guardian growth persist across courses; a newly created course starts with a fresh class streak.
Study Material now includes a Course Center for starting a new WGU course and marking a course passed.
Passing a course records completion, awards 500 Majick XP once, and shows a course-completion celebration.
Approved five-stage Guardian art is restored for sidebar/profile screens; walk/play/sleep action art remains Phaser-only.
Evolution action WebPs are normalized during deployment so transparent margins no longer make Guardians tiny or blank.
Home Sanctuary replacement is strengthened so the real Phaser Living Sanctuary replaces legacy habitat panels.
verified_working: JavaScript syntax checks for the patched main app, sanctuary Game.js, Preloader.js and service worker.
Question-bank analysis confirms 92 PMFC questions including 25 difficulty-4/5 items, so stronger difficulty rotation can occur without inventing course facts.
No save-schema reset is introduced; internal familiar ids remain luna/ember/nova/mallow for compatibility.
not_yet_browser_verified: Live user-browser animation timing and sound output after deployment.
Every sanctuary object interaction on the final GitHub Pages build.
study_now_change_note: No Study Now question, scoring, difficulty, XP, crystal, streak, answer, or course-progress logic changed.
save_compatibility: Additive-only. Existing XP, crystals, streaks, answers, course progress, Guardians, and sanctuary movement saves are preserved.

next_priorities: Upload the nine WebP object files to sanctuary/assets/objects/.
Visually tune object scale/placement after the real art is live.
Add evolution aura effects around moving sprites without changing their animation frames.
known_risks: First entry into the Living Sanctuary can still take time because the protected original motion PNGs total roughly 53 MB; they are intentionally not altered or recompressed.
One hard refresh is recommended after deployment so the new lightweight service worker replaces the old heavy cache.
release_rule: Every future Majick Studies build must update PROJECT_PROGRESS.md, app-progress.json and the in-app progress panel, and state whether Study Now logic changed and whether saves migrate safely.
placeholders: Sanctuary furniture is still mostly code-drawn until final transparent object art is added to GitHub.
protected_rules: Do not rewrite the original Guardian movement methods.
Do not edit, overwrite, rename, regenerate, or remove the original 33 files in sanctuary/assets/motion/.
Academic data from one course must never be surfaced as progress, notes, questions, mistakes, mastery, or streak data for another course.
Account XP and Guardian growth may persist across courses because they represent the learner, not a class.
runtime_architecture: legacy foundation compiled to one authoritative runtime; no deploy-time JavaScript body rewriting
sanctuary_runtime: Base Game.js + protected V3.3.10 movement + one V3.3.17 Sanctuary bridge
state_runtime: MajickStateCore owns shared XP/crystals/chests and safe course progress compatibility
guardian_runtime: MajickGuardianRegistry contains the current baseline canon and dynamically accepts future Guardians; care is roster-driven by pet.id
learning_intelligence: V3.4.2 adds D772 Section 2 Lesson 2 — Choosing Graphical Displays with corroborated bar-versus-pie rules, missing Other/Unknown checks, overlapping-category restrictions, histogram/scatterplot/line distinctions, eight new Tutor practice questions, and six new Game Realm scenarios. V3.4 Product Core, Lesson 1.2, Guardian relationship memory, shared render queue, source provenance, duplicate-safe hatching, Sanctuary movement, and protected assets remain preserved.
sanctuary_home: Every hatched Guardian has a distinct bed and personal nook, favorite keepsake and comfort item, need-driven and personality-driven room routines, physical care travel, visible protected Phaser movement, evolved idle/action art, evolution ceremony, Guardian vocal reactions, care inventory, and room-safe furniture layout
sanctuary_customization: personal Guardian nooks, feeding/play zones, owned furniture storage, Cozy Dorm layout preset
